title: DeALOG: Decentralized Multi-Agents Log-Mediated Reasoning Framework
abstract: arXiv:2602.00996v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Complex question answering across text, tables and images requires integrating diverse information sources. A framework supporting specialized processing with coordination and interpretability is needed. We introduce DeALOG, a decentralized multi-agent framework for multimodal question answering. It uses specialized agents: Table, Context, Visual, Summarizing and Verification, that communicate through a shared natural-language log as persistent memory. This log-based approach enables collaborative error detection and verification without central control, improving robustness. Evaluations on FinQA, TAT-QA, CRT-QA, WikiTableQuestions, FeTaQA, and MultiModalQA show competitive performance. Analysis confirms the importance of the shared log, agent specialization, and verification for accuracy. DeALOG, provides a scalable approach through modular components using natural-language communication.

translated_title: DeALOG：去中心化多智能体日志介导推理框架
translated_abstract: 跨文本、表格和图像的复杂问答需要整合多样化的信息来源，因此需要一个能够支持专业化处理、并具备协调性和可解释性的框架。我们提出了DeALOG，一个面向多模态问答的去中心化多智能体框架。它使用专业化的智能体——表格、上下文、视觉、摘要和验证智能体，这些智能体通过共享的自然语言日志作为持久记忆进行通信。这种基于日志的方法无需中央控制即可实现协作式错误检测和验证，从而提升鲁棒性。在FinQA、TAT-QA、CRT-QA、WikiTableQuestions、FeTaQA和MultiModalQA上的评估显示出具有竞争力的性能。分析证实了共享日志、智能体专业化和验证机制对准确性的重要性。DeALOG通过采用自然语言通信的模块化组件提供了一种可扩展的方法。
tldr: DeALOG是一个去中心化多智能体多模态问答框架，让专业化智能体通过共享自然语言日志作为持久记忆进行通信，在无中央控制的情况下实现协作式错误检测与验证，并在多个问答基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
en_tdlr: DeALOG is a decentralized multi-agent framework for multimodal question answering in which specialized agents communicate through a shared natural-language log as persistent memory, enabling collaborative error detection and verification without central control while achieving competitive performance across multiple QA benchmarks.
